    Explicit first-version choices

    Model assumptions

    • A new mist session starts at High intensity.
    • 1 simulated minute = 0.25 seconds in real time.
    • Changing a timed mode restarts the countdown.
    • A new mist session starts with the light off.
    • The LIGHT button works only while mist is active.
    • Refilling returns to Idle; it never restarts mist automatically.
    Mode cycle Off → Continuous → 30 → 60 → 120 → 180 → Off
    Safety rule Empty tank → mist off + light off + refill required
